quickerip.name: Quicker IP
quickerip.subtitle: Network toolkit for macOS
quickerip.tagline: Fast IP switching with presets, adapter management, system stats, speed test - and a powerful LAN scanner.
features: Live download/upload speed per adapter
Switch between DHCP, Static IP, and saved presets in seconds
Manage macOS Network Locations from the menu bar - create, rename, delete, and reorder services
Run a full LAN scan to see every device on your network
Test your connection speed without leaving the menu bar
Dante and pro audio network readiness - MTU, multicast, link speed, duplex, and subnet overlap
System Info Panel - CPU, RAM, Wi-Fi signal and more
SSID and full Wi-Fi details at a glance
Monitor all network adapters - Wi-Fi, Ethernet, USB, Thunderbolt, iPhone tethering
Click to copy any IP, subnet, gateway, or MAC address
IP change notifications - know immediately when your connection changes
Colour-coded status dots for instant adapter state recognition
Run at Login for always-on monitoring
quickerip.description: Everything you need to know about your network, one click away. Switch IP configs, run a speed test, scan the LAN, and check Dante readiness - without opening a terminal. Built for AV techs and IT professionals.

labassistant.name: Lab Assistant
labassistant.subtitle: QLab workspace automation for macOS
labassistant.tagline: Auto levels, auto top and tail, mono and multi-output routing - and Mint cleans up audio and video cues in place.
labassistant.description: Select your QLab cues, enable the modules you need, and hit Run All. Levels are auto-set to your LUFS target, mono routing and crosspoint outputs are configured, silence is trimmed, and cues are numbered and colour-coded, in seconds. And when a cue needs more than a fader move, Mint converts, cleans, and edits the audio without leaving Lab Assistant. Built for QLab 5, licensed and free.

targettrace.name: Target Trace
targettrace.subtitle: Target curve editor
targettrace.tagline: Build precise target curves for Smaart or REW - from scratch, your own measurements, or built-in presets.
features: Drag-and-drop control point editing with multi-select
Freehand draw mode with pencil cursor
Preset starting shapes - tilt, haystack, X-curve, and more
Simplify imported traces to clean editable curves
Transfer Function and Spectrum curve types
Convert any curve between TF and RTA and back, with no data loss
Split View - see your curve in both modes side by side
Z / A / C weighting filter for RTA view (IEC 61672)
Tolerance band overlay
Non-destructive smoothing (1, 1/3, 1/6, 1/12 octave)
Curve library with TF / Spectrum filter and drag-to-reorder (syncs Smaart's index)
Match Mode - sidebar follows your active TF / RTA tab
X and Y axis zoom with scroll, pinch, and keyboard
Save directly to Smaart TargetCurves folder
Drag a .crv file into Target Trace to open it
Export as REW house curve
targettrace.description: Build target curves from presets, draw them freehand, or import and reshape your own measurements. Target Trace gives you a visual editor for Smaart .crv files with drag-and-drop control points, tolerance bands, and one-click export back to Smaart or REW.

fetchpuppy.name: Fetch Puppy
fetchpuppy.subtitle: Find and save music and video for your projects
fetchpuppy.tagline: Find and save music and video - YouTube, Spotify playlists, TikTok, and more.
features: Search and save from YouTube without ads
Multi-source search with smart quality scoring
Preview search results before saving
Drag in a Spotify or Apple Music playlist - find every track automatically
Find and save music videos for an entire Spotify or Apple Music playlist
Save videos from TikTok, Instagram, X, Facebook, Reddit and more
Audio conversion to multiple formats with full metadata and artwork
Background processing with menu bar progress
fetchpuppy.description: Search YouTube and save without the ads. Drop in a Spotify or Apple Music playlist and Fetch Puppy finds every track - or every music video - automatically. Grabs video from TikTok, Instagram, X, Facebook, Reddit, and more, and converts audio to any format with full metadata and artwork.

ewp.name: EWP
ewp.subtitle: Elevated Work Platform
ewp.tagline: Set up your screens once. Snap into any layout instantly.
features: Spotter panel - drag apps in and EWP auto-arranges them instantly
Lift and Drop - raise your layout or clear your desktop in one click
6 layout modes - fullscreen, halves, big left, big right, and 4-up quad
Save presets and recall your exact setup instantly
Launch at Login - EWP opens a saved preset's apps and snaps them into place when you log in
Lock presets to a specific screen or apply them anywhere
Multiple monitor support - configure each screen independently
Lives in the menu bar - out of your way until you need it
ewp.description: Select a screen, pick a layout, assign your apps - EWP arranges everything automatically. Drop clears your desktop when you need a clean screen.
